ex: We visited an old Buddhist vihara in the mountains.
The monks live and study in the vihara.
Visitors must remove their shoes before entering the vihara.
The vihara is quiet early in the morning.
The negus was the king of old Ethiopia.
Our history book has a chapter about the negus.
The negus ruled the country for many years.
People bowed when the negus entered the hall.
negus.note: Historical title; also a British hot drink made with wine.

ex: Check the tachometer before you change gears.
The tachometer shows how fast the engine is turning.
My car's tachometer stopped working last week.
Keep the tachometer needle out of the red zone.
tachometer.note: Often shortened to "tach" in informal American English.

ex: The waiter tried an upsell with a bigger dessert.
Extra insurance is a common upsell at car rentals.
Our sales team gets a bonus for every upsell.
I said no to the upsell and kept the basic plan.
upsell.note: Also used as a verb: "to upsell a customer."

ex: Many small fish eat zooplankton in the ocean.
Whales can feed on huge amounts of zooplankton.
We looked at zooplankton under a microscope in class.
Warmer water can change how much zooplankton there is.
I finished my report in four pomodoros today.
Take a short break after each pomodoro.
Set a timer for one pomodoro and start working.
A pomodoro usually lasts twenty-five minutes.
My brother has been a headbanger since high school.
The front row was full of headbangers at the concert.
He dresses like a headbanger in black jeans.
Even old headbangers came to the reunion show.
headbanger.note: Informal word for a heavy metal fan.

ex: Our neighbors just got an Airedale terrier puppy.
An Airedale terrier needs a lot of exercise every day.
The Airedale terrier is the largest of the terriers.
My Airedale terrier loves to play in the yard.
My personal best deadlift is one hundred kilograms.
Keep your back straight during a deadlift.
I do deadlifts twice a week at the gym.
The trainer showed me how to do a safe deadlift.
My uncle still has a box of old laserdiscs.
A laserdisc is much bigger than a DVD.
We found a laserdisc player at the yard sale.
People watched movies on laserdisc before DVDs came out.
Sorry, I was AFK for a few minutes.
Going AFK now, I need to eat dinner.
The game kicks you out if you stay AFK too long.
Our teammate went AFK in the middle of the match.
AFK.note: Means "away from keyboard"; used in chat and games.

ex: The word cumshot is vulgar slang from adult films.
Cumshot is not a word to use at work or school.
The filter blocks words like cumshot in the chat.
Moderators removed the comment because it said cumshot.
cumshot.note: Very vulgar sexual slang; avoid in normal conversation.

ex: Laminin helps cells stick together in the body.
The scientists studied laminin in skin tissue.
Laminin is an important protein in our tissues.
Our biology teacher explained what laminin does.
A propyl group has three carbon atoms.
The label lists propyl alcohol as an ingredient.
In class we drew the structure of a propyl group.
Propyl compounds are used in some cleaning products.
propyl.note: Usually used before another noun, like "propyl alcohol."

ex: Upcycling old jeans into bags is fun and cheap.
She sells furniture she made through upcycling.
Upcycling helps reduce waste at home.
Our school held an upcycling workshop on Saturday.
